items.value: You are really digging into my localization???? However, I want rework some of these events in the future since I am not satisfied with their current state, haha.

Disappearing Characters
Every npc becomes invisible while player is still visible!

Cold Event
Works like fog, but in addition slowdowns everyone with its coldness.

Portal Chaos
Mysterious Portals appear everywhere.

Voting Time
This event helps to the school accept or decline some suggestions, let's vote!
